title: 第15章 癫狂的公主要杀掉第16章 云舒之死
slug: 暮年太子每天增加一点精神
content_zh:
难道夏皇就是袭击夏无恙的真凶？
墨千秋的心中，早已泛起过这个想法，可是思来想去，又觉得可能性不大。
当时的太子虽然意气风发，权势、修为、派系……都在迅速壮大，但是跟夏皇比起来，还是差了太远太远。
而且太子也不是野心勃勃之人，就算夏皇对其心生忌惮，也不至于对他下那样的狠手。
甚至在太子被废没多久，就连皇后也死于走火入魔，看似并没有什么异常之处，但是事情未免太巧合了。
皇后身死以后，已经被废的太子再无威胁，尤其是随着太子派系分崩离析，夏皇已然高枕无忧。
可是只因为这点儿威胁，就废了自己最出色的儿子之一，连自己的皇后都不放过，是不是有些太夸张了。
根据他这么多年对夏皇的了解，他并非如此疯狂之人，难道其中还有什么内幕。
墨千秋不得而知，有心想要调查，可是如今太子已然垂垂老矣，说不定几个月后就要走了，还有必要调查这一切吗。
雨越下越大，墨千秋最后望了一眼文华殿残破的琉璃瓦，转身没入雨幕。
袖中那方旧帕不知何时已攥得死紧，褪色的墨梅染上了点点猩红，那是指甲嵌入掌心的血。
这位昔日辅佐夏无恙经营了好大一个派系的忠臣谋士，似乎也彻底放弃了。
他不知道的是，距离他数百米外的文华殿练功室中，夏无恙已然踏入六品圆满，未来前途无量。
修为突破，巩固和适应一番，眼看着时间不短了，夏无恙再次回到寝殿，继续陪伴龟兹舞女们宴饮欢乐，暗中则悄无声息地修行和提升。
看似沉醉于声色犬马，实则体内真气奔腾如潮。
宫内宫外的嗤笑之声仍旧不绝于耳，文华殿中的夏无恙却是一日千里，修为实力迅速增长。
精神力量每增加一点，他的修炼速度也会增加一些，综合实力随之增加。
不知不觉中，幽冥绝脉针已经来到瓶颈，丝丝缕缕的黑气在他十指之间缭绕。
他再次躲到了练功室中，准备冲击小成之境。
黑气如同有着自己的生命，在他的指间跳跃，时而化作细针，时而散若烟雾。

“凝……”
某一刻，夏无恙低喝一声，黑气骤然收缩，在他的指尖凝成三枚近乎透明的细针。
针长三寸，细若牛毛，在灯光下泛着微不可察的光芒。
“总算成了！”
夏无恙长舒一口气，额头上渗出细密的汗珠。
幽冥绝脉，针出无息，小成之境，三日毙敌！
已经突破小成之境的幽冥绝脉针，能够在敌人的体内潜伏三日，三日后才会发作，致敌人于死地。
content_en:
Could it be that Emperor Xia was the real culprit who attacked Xia Wuyang?
This idea had already appeared in Mo Qianqiu's mind, but after thinking about it, he felt that it was unlikely.
Although the prince at that time was very high-spirited and his power, cultivation, and factions were all growing rapidly, he was still far behind Emperor Xia.
Moreover, the prince was not an ambitious person. Even if Emperor Xia was jealous of him, he would not be so cruel to him.
Even not long after the prince was deposed, even the queen died of a madness. There seemed to be nothing unusual, but it was too coincidental.
After the queen's death, the deposed prince was no longer a threat, especially as the prince's faction fell apart, Emperor Xia had no worries.
But just because of this threat, he killed one of his most outstanding sons, even his own queen. Isn't it a bit exaggerated?
Based on his understanding of Emperor Xia over the years, he is not such a crazy person. Is there any inside story behind this?
Mo Qianqiu didn't know, and wanted to investigate, but now that the prince was old and might be leaving in a few months, was it still necessary to investigate all of this.
The rain was getting heavier and heavier. Mo Qianqiu took one last look at the broken glazed tiles of Wenhua Hall, then turned around and disappeared into the rain.
The old square handkerchief in the sleeve had been clenched tightly at some point, and the faded plum blossoms were stained with bits of scarlet, which was the blood from the nails embedded in the palm of the hand.
This loyal advisor who had assisted Xia Wuyang in running a large faction seemed to have given up completely.
What he didn't know was that in the Wenhua Hall practice room a few hundred meters away from him, Xia Wuyang had already reached the sixth level of perfection and had a bright future.
After making a breakthrough in cultivation, he consolidated and adapted. Seeing that time was running out, Xia Wuyang returned to the dormitory again and continued to accompany the Kucha dancers to feast and have fun, while secretly cultivating and improving.
It seems that he is intoxicated by the sensuality of dogs and horses, but in fact, the true energy in his body is rushing like a tide.
The laughter inside and outside the palace was still endless, but Xia Wuyang in the Wenhua Palace was making rapid progress, and his cultivation strength was growing rapidly.
Every time his spiritual power increases, his cultivation speed will also increase, and his overall strength will increase accordingly.
Unknowingly, the Netherworld Jueming Needle had reached the bottleneck, and strands of black energy lingered between his fingers.
He hid in the practice room again, preparing to hit the realm of small success.
The black energy seemed to have its own life, jumping between his fingers, sometimes turning into fine needles, sometimes dispersing like smoke.
"Ning..."
At a certain moment, Xia Wuyang let out a low drink, and the black energy suddenly shrank, condensing into three almost transparent needles on his fingertips.
The needle is three inches long, as thin as a cow's hair, and glows imperceptibly under the light.
"It's finally done!"
Xia Wuyang breathed a long sigh of relief, and beads of sweat broke out on his forehead.
The pulse of the underworld is dead, the needle is breathless, and in the realm of small success, the enemy can be killed in three days!
The Netherworld Absolute Meridian Needle, which has broken through the realm of Xiaocheng, can lurk in the enemy's body for three days. It will take effect after three days, killing the enemy.
